questions.label: 1(a)
questions.stem:
Research has shown that the likelihood of a person having red hair is attributed to the genes inherited from each parent (one gene from each parent); other factors are involved too. A research group (A) is exploring relationships between genes and red hair in a community. A random sample of $1500$ people from the community are studied; a probability tree diagram illustrates the results. Event $G$: people that have two red hair genes. Event $G'$: people that do not have two red hair genes. Event $C$: people that have red hair. Event $C'$: people that do not have red hair.

Write down the missing items in the table. Probability notation → description in the context: $P(G\cap C)$ → probability of selecting a person who has two red hair genes and has red hair; $P(G\cap C')$ → probability of selecting a person who has two red hair genes and does not have red hair; $P(\square\cap\square)$ → probability of selecting a person who does not have two red hair genes and has red hair; $P(G'\cap C')$ → probability of selecting a person who $\square$.

questions.label: 3(e)
questions.stem:
HAMJO is another organization reviewing its carbon emissions. If HAMJO does not install filters in the next 8 years, they must buy 222 kt of carbon units. If HAMJO installs filters: installation costs 14 million dollars; emissions reduce to 77 kt per year. The graph shows HAMJO at 77 kt and government limits. Complete the table using the graph.
$$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Year} & 2022 & 2023 & 2024 & 2025 & 2026 & 2027 & 2028 & 2029 & 2030 \\ \hline \text{Difference(kt)} & 28 & 19.5 & \square & \square & 0 & 4.5 & 8 & \square & \square \\ \hline \text{Value(million dollars)} & 1.68 & \square & \square & \square & \text{--} & 0.27 & \square & \square & \square \\ \hline \text{Buy or sell} & \text{sell} & \text{sell} & \text{sell} & \text{sell} & \text{--} & \text{buy} & \text{buy} & \text{buy} & \text{buy} \\ \hline\end{array}$$
Carbon units cost approximately 60000 dollars per kt to buy or sell.

HAMJO needs to know if installing filters will help the organization save money. Analyse the data to make a recommendation. In your answer provide: three relevant factors; calculations for selling and buying carbon units, with and without filters; recommendations for whether to install filters; a justification for the degree of accuracy in the context of the question.

figures.alt: HAMJO carbon-emission graph:77 kt horizontal red points; government blue limits. Screenshot lower graph axis is truncated. Full annual table is retained as editable data.
